newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Trust up after bond terms set.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Trust up after bond terms set.

text.p: Sumitomo Trust & Banking Co Ltd shares rose in Friday's morning session on relief that the bank's exchangeable bond terms had been set, brokers said.
As of 0125 GMT, the shares were up 50 yen or 4.85 percent at 1,080, the sixth-largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.

"After the bond terms were set on Thursday, dealers believe that a factor with the potential to depress the shares has disappeared and they are buying back the shares," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said.
In recent weeks, talk of equity financing by the bank had been dampening the share price.
